headline: Baidu shares slide to record low on third-quarter earnings and AI headwinds
summary: Shares of Baidu fell to an all-time low as investors reacted negatively to third-quarter financial results and mounting concerns over its artificial intelligence monetization.
why: Baidu is China's primary search engine provider and an early domestic leader in autonomous driving and generative AI development.

impacts.name: Baidu
impacts.why: Weakness in quarterly earnings and concerns about AI business traction drove the stock to a record low.
